hook.en: With a stack you can only put something on top or take the top thing off. Those two moves are PUSH and POP.
hook.kn: ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಇಡುವುದು ಅಥವಾ ಮೇಲಿನದನ್ನು ತೆಗೆಯುವುದು ಮಾತ್ರ ಸಾಧ್ಯ. ಅವೇ PUSH ಮತ್ತು POP.

objectives.en: Trace a sequence of stack operations

narration.en: With a stack you can only put something on top or take the top thing off. Those two moves are PUSH and POP.
narration.kn: ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಇಡುವುದು ಅಥವಾ ಮೇಲಿನದನ್ನು ತೆಗೆಯುವುದು ಮಾತ್ರ ಸಾಧ್ಯ. ಅವೇ PUSH ಮತ್ತು POP.

body.en: PUSH adds a new element at the TOP of the stack; it is an insertion. Adding to a stack that is already full is an exception called overflow. POP removes the topmost element; it is a deletion. Removing from an empty stack is called underflow. Other helpful operations are isEmpty, top (peek at the top element) and size.

points.en: PUSH: insert at TOP; full stack → overflow
POP: delete from TOP; empty stack → underflow
isEmpty, top (peek), size help to use a stack safely

narration.en: PUSH adds a new element at the TOP of the stack; it is an insertion. Adding to a stack that is already full is an exception called overflow. POP removes the topmost element; it is a deletion. Removing from an empty stack is called underflow. Other helpful operations are isEmpty, top (peek at the top element) and size.
narration.kn: PUSH ಹೊಸ ಅಂಶವನ್ನು TOP ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ತುಂಬಿದ ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಕ್‌ಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿದರೆ ಓವರ್‌ಫ್ಲೋ. POP ಮೇಲಿನ ಅಂಶ ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಖಾಲಿ ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಕ್‌ನಿಂದ ತೆಗೆಯಲು ಯತ್ನಿಸಿದರೆ ಅಂಡರ್‌ಫ್ಲೋ.

caption.en: Watch PUSH and POP change the TOP of a stack.

tryThis.en: Push 5, 8, 3 and watch the TOP move up.
Pop until the stack is empty, then pop once more: what message appears?

narration.en: Watch PUSH and POP change the TOP of a stack. Push 5, 8, 3 and watch the TOP move up. Pop until the stack is empty, then pop once more: what message appears?

problem.en: Glasses are stacked one by one: PUSH glass1, PUSH glass2, POP, PUSH glass3, PUSH glass4, POP. Show the stack after each step.

steps.en: PUSH glass3, PUSH glass4 → [glass1, glass3, glass4]; POP removes glass4 → [glass1, glass3]

answer.en: Final stack (bottom to top): glass1, glass3; TOP = glass3

narration.en: Trace the stack after every operation. Remember that POP always takes the top element.

body.en: To check whether a pop order is possible, simulate it: push the inputs in order until the wanted element is on top, then pop it. If the wanted element is buried below the top, that order is impossible.

narration.en: Stack permutations. To check whether a pop order is possible, simulate it: push the inputs in order until the wanted element is on top, then pop it. If the wanted element is buried below the top, that order is impossible.

mnemonic.en: Wanted on top? Pop. Buried? Impossible.

points.en: PUSH inserts at the TOP; POP deletes from the TOP.
points.kn: PUSH TOP ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; POP TOP ನಿಂದ ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Overflow: push on a full stack. Underflow: pop on an empty stack.
points.kn: ಓವರ್‌ಫ್ಲೋ: ತುಂಬಿದ ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಕ್‌ಗೆ PUSH. ಅಂಡರ್‌ಫ್ಲೋ: ಖಾಲಿ ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಕ್‌ನಿಂದ POP.

homework.en: Trace PUSH 10, PUSH 20, POP, PUSH 30, POP, POP, POP and mark where underflow occurs.

narration.en: Recap. PUSH inserts at the TOP; POP deletes from the TOP. Overflow: push on a full stack. Underflow: pop on an empty stack. Always check isEmpty before POP.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. PUSH TOP ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; POP TOP ನಿಂದ ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಓವರ್‌ಫ್ಲೋ: ತುಂಬಿದ ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಕ್‌ಗೆ PUSH. ಅಂಡರ್‌ಫ್ಲೋ: ಖಾಲಿ ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಕ್‌ನಿಂದ POP. POP ಮೊದಲು isEmpty ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.
